Card Q&A.a: No, the target original "1 of your other Digimon" for this effect does not have to be red.
Card Q&A.q: If I use this card's [When Digivolving] effect to digivolve into a level 4 red Digimon, does my other Digimon have to be red?

I used this Digimon's [When Digivolving] effect to DNA digivolve, and this caused the memory gauge to move on my opponent's side. Is it possible to use this card's inherited effect to DNA digivolve again at the end of the turn?

Effect: [When Digivolving] Activate 1 of the effects below.
・1 of your other Digimon may digivolve into a red level 4 Digimon card with [Free] in its traits from your trash for the cost.
・This Digimon and one of your other Digimon may DNA digivolve into a Digimon card in your hand for the cost.
Inherited Effect: [End of Your Turn] This Digimon and one of your other Digimon may DNA digivolve into a Digimon card in your hand for the cost.
